records.name: Palomino
records.tagline: Ultrafast workspace for agents to run in parallel
records.description: Palomino is a fast, GPU-rendered agent workspace. Run agents side by side with your terminals, editor, and browser in one window.

records.name: Mermaid
records.tagline: Tell your Mac what to do. From literally anywhere
records.description: You know when you’re out and remember the one thing that’s sitting on your Mac at home? That’s why we made Mermaid. You just text your Mac from your iPhone, like you’d text a friend, and it actually does the thing. It opens your apps, finds the file, writes the email, almost do anything and you can watch it happen on your phone.It’s not a chatbot and it’s not remote desktop. It just gets stuff done.

records.name: Helicon
records.tagline: Open-source desktop app and VS Code panel for Muse Code
records.description: Helicon gives Muse Code, Meta's coding agent CLI, a proper home: projects and sessions in one sidebar, readable approvals, inline diffs and your plan meter. Free, MIT, no API key. Windows (no WSL), macOS, Linux, VS Code. Unofficial, not affiliated with Meta.

records.name: Maybloc
records.tagline: new SOTA for speech-to-text for multi-speaker audio
records.description: Speech-to-text built for conversations with more than one voice with highest accuracy than any in the industry. Lowest diarization error on several benchmarks. 45 languages, up to 25 speakers. Add-ons: subtitles, PII redaction, summaries, speaker names, translation. Better than Pyannote, Deepgram and Assembly AI

records.name: Tidy Design
records.tagline: Open Source Paper / Figma Alternative
records.description: Tidy is an open source alternative to Figma and Paper for designers, engineers, and AI agents. Design interfaces directly from your coding harness (Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, etc), explore the source code, and adapt the tool to fit how you work.

records.name: GBrain Tools
records.tagline: A password manager for AI
records.description: GBrain Tools is a password manager for AI. Connect Gmail, GitHub, Stripe, Notion and many more once, then use them from ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Cursor or your terminal. No AI holds a password, and every action lands on one log. $19 a month.

records.name: Toad
records.tagline: Point your agent at any machine you own.
records.description: Toad lets Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, or any MCP client run commands and work with files on all your machines through one MCP server. Install a small service on each machine. No open ports, and every change asks for your approval.

records.name: Nudgebox
records.tagline: Send push notifications without building an app
records.description: Put a QR code on your site, receipt or status page. People scan it with the free Nudgebox iPhone app and choose what to hear about. No account, email or phone number. Your backend reaches them with one HTTPS call. No SDK, no device tokens.

records.name: iKnowMyMac
records.tagline: See why your Mac is slow, with the evidence and the fix
records.description: iKnowMyMac is a native Mac app that tells you why your Mac is slow, what's filling your disk and what's draining your battery, with the evidence and one action for each. It also updates your other apps from one tab. One-time purchase, no subscription.

records.name: Jockey by TwelveLabs
records.tagline: Your entire video library: organized, searchable, understood
records.description: Jockey is the first AI that understands your entire media library across photos and video. It analyzes thousands of hours of footage so you can find and connect people, moments and context across videos. Use it in Claude or ChatGPT, or build with the API/SDK. Ingest YouTube, TikTok and Instagram Reels links; assemble content into MP4s; and create and share video-driven artifacts with playable clips. Every TwelveLabs model upgrade makes Jockey better, without re-integration.

records.name: Sparrow
records.tagline: Self-hosted webhook delivery. One binary, just Postgres.
records.description: Send webhooks reliably from your infrastructure. Retries, cryptographic signing, health tracking, payload transforms, recipes for Slack/Discord/PagerDuty, and a self-service portal — in one Go binary with PostgreSQL as the only dependency. Free, MIT.

records.name: Skisso
records.tagline: Edit your live UI in your design system, hand off the diff
records.description: Skisso is a free Chrome extension for designers and developers who build with AI coding agents. Point at any element on your live product and edit it in your own design system: your tokens, your components, a shadcn/ui kit that matches your styles. Then hand your agent only the exact change, as a small diff or over MCP. No more describing pixels in prose or pasting the whole page: about 380 tokens instead of 25,700 in our test. Runs locally, no account.

records.name: Atelier
records.tagline: The studio your AI coding agents work in
records.description: Atelier makes your Claude plan last: Codex finds the problems and Claude only judges them (about 71% fewer Claude tokens per review), long chats hand over to fresh sessions, and every session starts from a short brief. Every app you make keeps its tasks, releases, feedback and memory here, and you approve finished work. Native Mac app, 7 days free.

records.name: Neophyte
records.tagline: Watch an AI agent sign up and onboard to any product
records.description: Give Neophyte any product URL and watch an AI agent onboard from scratch. It creates an identity, signs up, verifies its email, navigates setup, and attempts activation. Use the captured product flow and friction report to find drop-off risks, audit launches, test onboarding changes, research competitors, and improve experiences for humans and agents.

records.name: Scalebrowser
records.tagline: Human browser capabilities. Now for AI agents.
records.description: Scalebrowser is self-hosted browser infrastructure for AI agents. It gives each agent a persistent, isolated identity, keeps logins and passkeys intact, handles captchas and verification, and runs on hardware you control.

records.name: Calenteri
records.tagline: SaaS where a user can can book appointments to other users.
records.description: The GDPR-compliant alternative to Calendly. Share a booking link, let people pick a time. EU-hosted, zero third-party trackers, no cookie banners. With this app User A can book an appointment from User B's calendar. User B can set when he is available etc. User B will get an email when someone has booked an appointment from his calendar. User A will also get an email when the booking is done. User B has to share the link to people. User B can cancel appointments.

records.name: Taim
records.tagline: Capture it. Taim files, schedules & syncs it with your AI.
records.description: Taim is your thought-capture assistant. Speak your mind and it all falls into place: thoughts land in the right thread automatically, and to-dos become tasks, reminders, and calendar events. Connect via MCP, and every agent you use instantly has your context.

records.name: FinderGit
records.tagline: Every Git repo on your Mac: browse, commit, review, clean
records.description: A native Mac file browser with Git built in: every repo's branch, status and changes in one window. New since launch, in 60 releases: • AI commit messages, built in or with your own key • Branches, stash, merge and rebase, no terminal • Dashboards for each repo and your whole workspace • Issues & PRs from GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg, Bitbucket • Repo Trust: see what a repo auto-runs before you open it • Cleaning: reclaim GBs of rebuildable dev junk. 100% native SwiftUI. No Electron. macOS 15+.

records.name: Kalesh Judge
records.tagline: Turn petty fights into a public trial
records.description: An anonymous entertainment courtroom for everyday disagreements. Turn petty fights into a public trial. Vote, pitch your funniest fix, climb the leaderboard, and summon your WhatsApp panchayat. Kalesh Judge is live!

records.name: Fish Audio Drama 3
records.tagline: AI voice acting you can direct, not just generate
records.description: Drama 3 is Fish Audio's latest AI voice model, built for performances you can direct. Turn scripts into expressive speech with natural-language control over emotion, pacing, whispers, laughter, and pauses — even within a single sentence. Create multi-character scenes, audiobooks, game dialogue, and narration across 83 languages. Available on the web, mobile, and API, with open weights for self-hosting under Fish Audio's community license.

records.name: NANI???
records.tagline: Your interpreter and your boss doesn't even know.
records.description: NANI??? Ever sat through a call understanding nothing, then realised someone just asked you a question? Nani? learns who’s speaking by voice, right on your Mac, and floats live translated subtitles over any call. No bot joins, so nobody sees a thing. When your boss asks you something, it chimes and suggests replies you can say back, even in a language you don’t speak. Add context and a glossary before the call, and get a summary with action items after. Next time, you won’t have to say NANI???

records.name: Firefox Enterprise
records.tagline: Firefox for enterprises that want control of their data
records.description: Firefox Enterprise brings Mozilla's independent browser technology to organizations that want more control over their IT infrastructure and data. Built on the Gecko engine, it offers a self-hosted management console for centrally managing browser policies, access, data movement, and AI usage. It works alongside existing identity, security, and device management systems, helping enterprises reduce dependence on dominant browser ecosystems.

records.name: Memory Chess
records.tagline: Study a chess position, then rebuild it from memory
records.description: Memory Chess shows you a chess position for a few seconds, clears the board, and you put the pieces back. Version 2.0 is our biggest update yet: a daily board everyone plays once, a skill rating that moves both ways, a dashboard of your memory span and progress, shareable round replays, and a redesign in 24 languages. Free, no account. Come say hi and swap scores with other players on Telegram: t.me/TheMemoryChess

records.name: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL
records.tagline: NVIDIA’s open multimodal model for specialized agents
records.description: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is NVIDIA’s open, customizable multimodal model for specialized agents. It is a 120B mixture-of-experts model with 12B active parameters that handles text, image, document, and video input, plus reasoning and tool use, in one model. NVIDIA claims up to 5x higher agentic throughput on a single GPU than open models its size. Checkpoints, training recipes, and datasets are on Hugging Face, with a NIM container.

records.name: Tesla Roadster
records.tagline: The hypercar that flies
records.description: Roadster can perform at levels unlike any other production car. It goes beyond Plaid to unlock an entirely new dimension of driving. It challenges the limits of design, engineering and physics to deliver an expertly crafted extra-terrestrial vehicle.

records.name: DOYT
records.tagline: The  Dynamic Island to-do app you don't have to open
records.description: Stop writing todos you'll forget the moment you close the app. DOYT pins your current task to Dynamic Island & Lock Screen—visible while you text, scroll, or watch videos. Touch and hold to complete a task or move it to Later without opening DOYT. Features an optional focus timer (30 min–8 h), a history calendar, Siri & Shortcuts. Core features are free forever; Pro is a one-time purchase with a 3-day trial (no card needed). No sign-up, no ads.

records.name: Lovable Growth Tools
records.tagline: From building your app to growing it, in one chat
records.description: Lovable can now help you grow your business. Set a goal like “my first 100 signups” and get a launch playbook built from your app. Launch ads to Google Search, YouTube, Maps, Facebook and Instagram. Get found in Google and AI search with Semrush data. Create images, video and copy from your builds. Unlike an agency or a pile of tools, it lives next to your app and traffic, and you approve before anything spends.

records.name: Harness by Autonomous
records.tagline: Every coding agent, every machine, one command center.
records.description: Harness is the open-source command center for coding agents. Claude Code at work, Codex at home, Hermes in the cloud: every agent on every machine, side by side. Use the native desktop app, hn in your terminal, or the iOS and Android app to answer agents by voice. End-to-end encrypted. Then go beyond code with 49 harnesses for CAD, circuits, robots, games and music. Free on Mac and Linux.

records.name: Grablo Spot
records.tagline: Free AI NVR that finds any person or vehicle in seconds
records.description: Grablo Spot is free AI NVR software for the cameras you already have. It records straight to your own machine and sorts every person and vehicle it sees into cards. Find anyone by face, appearance, plain text ("a person in a yellow shirt"), or a partial license plate, then follow them across every camera. Works with IP cameras, NVRs (RTSP/ONVIF), and USB webcams on Windows, macOS, Linux, and Raspberry Pi. Video is stored only on your device. No credit card, no camera limit, every feature free.

records.name: Muse Spark Open
records.tagline: The most capable US open weights model to date
records.description: Meta's open weights model built for coding and agentic work. 816B total parameters with 42B active, a 1M token context window and native multimodal input. Download the weights on Hugging Face or run it on two M5 Ultra Mac Studios with MLX.

records.name: Tetriz Harness
records.tagline: Turn what your team learns into everyone’s agent setup
records.description: Open-source tools for teams on Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Kiro. Harness Recommendations finds what’s broken in your agents’ rules, skills, hooks, and permissions, and what’s missing based on your team’s sessions. Control Plane ships fixes team-wide.

records.name: Dottr
records.tagline: Agent that drafts contracts, flags risks + gets them signed
records.description: Dottr is an AI teammate for contracts that lives in your email. Forward a thread or notes and it drafts the agreement from your templates, reviews risks in plain English, sends it for signature, and chases every signer until it’s done. Signers need no login. It also remembers the terms and dates so you can ask what you agreed later. From draft to signed instantly, so the yes doesn’t go cold.

records.name: Pomerado
records.tagline: Turn any website into an API; Faster & reliable browser use
records.description: Pomerado turns any website into a MCP / API in minutes. Automate everything by turning previously inaccessible websites (like Google Flights, Zillow, Instacart, legacy portals) into native tools for your agents. Our open-source tool builds, hosts, authenticates, and maintains your integrations, so you can focus on building.

records.name: Agent Vault
records.tagline: Superpowers for your Agents
records.description: Your agent fills checkout and sign-in forms with mock tokens. Real card numbers and passwords are substituted inside a secure enclave it can never see.

records.name: Holm
records.tagline: A self hosted home page for everyone in the house
records.description: Holm is a self hosted dashboard for the people who use your server, not just you. Everyone signs in with your existing SSO and gets their own apps, layout and wallpaper. One search box reaches inside Immich, Jellyfin, Plex, Paperless, your calendar and many more integrations.

records.name: SignWith
records.tagline: E-signatures without the subscription. Pay per doc.
records.description: Sign 3 documents free every month, then buy one-time credit packs from $9. Every account gets signing order, email OTP verification, audit trail and certificate of completion. Send from the app, the API, or AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT using the MCP.

records.name: Parallax
records.tagline: Every coding agent you run, in one place.
records.description: Parallax runs your coding agents for you. Claude Code, Codex and 40+ more in one app, with 240+ models on your own subscriptions. Captain handles the busywork, fast merge ships your PRs in one click, and when a subscription runs out, auto fallback enables your work to move to the next.

records.name: Hintly for Google Meet™
records.tagline: Real-time hints for every term you miss on Google Meet
records.description: Hintly explains the terms, names and things people mention on your Google Meet calls, a moment after they come up.

records.name: BOSS Console
records.tagline: A tiny OS for your always-on agents
records.description: BOSS Console is a tiny OS for your always-on agents. Create your own agent with real tools, chat at fluck.ai, and access live sessions at cli.risaboss.com.

records.name: ClipDesk
records.tagline: Open Source, Video, Content Creation, Productivity
records.description: ClipDesk transforms regular widescreen screen recordings into polished 9:16 vertical videos for Instagram Reels, Shorts, and TikTok. Instead of spending 30 minutes in Premiere or CapCut manually cropping and keyframing cursor movements, ClipDesk’s virtual camera glides along with your mouse pointer, zooms in smoothly on mouse clicks, adds automatic word-by-word captions on-device via Whisper, and polishes your mic audio. Available as a Windows app, Chrome/Edge extension, and web app.

records.name: Cooler
records.tagline: Coolify - in your pocket.
records.description: A simple mobile companion for checking and managing your Coolify infrastructure. What it does right now: - Real-time container metrics and health diagnostics. - Live deployment log streaming directly from your pocket. - Native background alerts and notification rules (with quiet hours). - Biometric lock (FaceID / fingerprint) with instant app blur. It's completely free and open source (AGPLv3), zero webview/electron bloat, and doesn't route your API keys or data through any third-party servers.

records.name: EdgeLog
records.tagline: The AI trading journal built for small-cap traders
records.description: EdgeLog is a trading journal built for small-cap and scalp traders. Most journals just log entries, exits and P&L. EdgeLog tracks behavior: when your losses cluster, whether you lose on bad setups or good setups exited wrong, and what your best week did differently. An AI coach flags those patterns for you, and it connects to Claude and ChatGPT. $15/month. Built by a trader, for traders.

records.name: Easy Baby Monitor
records.tagline: Turn your old phones into a secure, encrypted baby monitor
records.description: Turn two phones or tablets into a video baby monitor. Live video, two-way talk, lullabies, cry and motion alerts, over Wi-Fi or mobile data.

records.name: SceneAnvil
records.tagline: Unified 4K AI video & image studio with 38 SOTA models
records.description: Synthesize cinema-grade 4K AI video and photorealistic stills across 38 foundation engines including Kling 3.0 Pro, Wan 2.7, Seedance 2.5, and Flux. Zero vendor lock-in with unified director camera controls.

records.name: FastUp | Non-custodial trading terminal
records.tagline: Advanced HUD analytics for Trenches, swap & monitoring tools
records.description: FastUp.trade combines market discovery, blockchain trading, portfolio analysis, and community into a single mobile experience. Why FastUp? - Explore the Solana markets - Stay in control of your trades - Manage your portfolio - Join FastUp HQ - Level up in FastUp Join early and help us shape the next generation of DeFi trading tools!

records.name: Murmr
records.tagline: Offline Private Dictation, Free for Life.
records.description: Murmr is AI dictation that runs on your own computer. Press a key, speak, and clean text appears wherever your cursor is, in any app. Unlimited and free for life, works offline, on Windows and Mac. Pro is $29.99 once, no subscription.

records.name: E-Arrival Card for OCI Holders
records.tagline: Guide to E-Arrival Card Requirements, Application Steps
records.description: Traveling to India with an OCI card in 2026? Learn about the mandatory e-Arrival Card, the 72-hour submission window, required details, application steps, and official government portal.

records.name: AGENTCODI - PKG Edition
records.tagline: A native development environment with an integrated codex
records.description: Native Codex development on Android. AGENTCODI Package Edition combines AI coding sessions, a terminal, and a signed APT package catalog to turn your phone into a development workspace. - Mcpasi/AGENTCODI-Package-Edition

records.name: Piano: Soloist
records.tagline: Sheet music, falling notes and keyboard in one synced view.
records.description: Interactive MusicXML & MIDI score player with synced sheet music, falling notes & keyboard. No app store download needed—runs in browser or as a Web App (PWA). Features: Pianistic touch: Smart melody & hand balance Complete dynamics, pedal & exact repeats Listen mode: Screen-off playback (iOS/Android) Practice tools: Bar jump, looping & speed control Free playback included. Lifetime Pro ($19.99) adds Medley mode, 16-velocity grand piano, unlimited saved scores & more.

records.name: MCP Linker
records.tagline: Sync MCP servers between Claude Code, Codex, Cursor & more
records.description: Copy MCP servers between Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Copilot & Claude Desktop, across projects and scopes, in one two-pane view. Configs are converted for each client automatically. Plus one-click install from the MCP Registry. Fully local.

records.name: VOX Limit Orders Per Day
records.tagline: Simplify Shopify Order Management with VOX
records.description: Keep orders manageable with VOX Limit Orders Per Day. Set limits for specific weekdays, control product quantities, and avoid accepting more orders than your business can fulfill. A useful solution for Shopify stores managing limited stock or fulfillment capacity.

records.name: Marino Leads
records.tagline: All-in-one AI Go-To-Market & B2B Sales Copilot
records.description: Marino Leads is an integrated AI-powered B2B Go-To-Market platform that unifies 7 core commercial engines into one workspace: verified corporate contact discovery, dynamic Email/WhatsApp campaigns, visual CRM pipeline, and team task delegation—boosted by C.L.O.S.E. AI Copilot for knowledge-grounded objection handling and an AI meeting recorder that delivers verbatim transcripts, speaker diarization, and automatic BANT qualification to turn discovery calls into closed deals.

records.name: ActivePray
records.tagline: Daily prayer, kept active.
records.description: Daily prayer times for iPhone across Judaism, Christianity and Islam: eight branches, each with its own calendar and hours. Offline-first and private.

records.name: Telzivo
records.tagline: Turnkey White-Label eSIM Platform & Wholesale APIs
records.description: Launch your turnkey white-label eSIM business in 5 mins. 200+ global destinations, 1-Click iOS/Android install, Stripe payouts, and wholesale telecom APIs.

records.name: FishMeteo
records.tagline: Fishing forecasts, tides and marine weather
records.description: Plan fishing trips with forecasts, bite windows, tides, wind, waves and marine weather in one app. Save fishing spots and keep a fishing journal. Available on iPhone and Android, free to download with optional in-app purchases. Forecasts are estimates, not guarantees of catches.

records.name: Re:Stance
records.tagline: Leave a judgment today, and it will be waiting for you.
records.description: Most explainers hand you a conclusion. Re:Stance hands you the argument, then asks where you stand — one line, your own words. Commit, and it shows the single strongest counter aimed at your side. Not a list. One. Keep your position or change it; either way it’s recorded. Later the issue returns, and so does the sentence you wrote. Nothing is scored. Both sides can be right — what’s measured is only whether you answered. 14 languages. Judging is free, forever. Not available in the EU/UK.

records.name: GC Life Science
records.tagline: Laboratory Equipment Supplier in India
records.description: GC Life Science is a trusted distributor and stockist of high-quality laboratory instruments, reagents, application-specific kits, chemicals, plasticware, and glassware.

records.name: GlanceCard
records.tagline: Daily GitHub cards for your READMEs, in nine looks
records.description: GlanceCard draws SVG cards of your GitHub profile and repositories every morning, with a GitHub Action in your own repository, and commits them as plain files for your READMEs. No server, no third-party service, no dependencies. • A dashboard for any repository • A profile card for you • Your year as a chart, or GitHub's grid • Nine looks, Halloween and Christmas in their season • A setup the website writes for your looks. Free and MIT-licensed, on the GitHub Marketplace.

records.name: AITENYA: AI Personal Trainer
records.tagline: Your iPhone counts reps and gives spoken form cues
records.description: AITENYA helps women train at home with an iPhone camera. Apple Vision uses on-device machine learning to track visible body landmarks. AITENYA applies exercise-specific movement checks to count supported reps, time holds, and give spoken form cues when the camera has a clear view. AI-assisted coaching happens on your iPhone; workout video is not uploaded.

records.name: StickerMatchCut
records.tagline: Drop a sticker. Get a sticker slap match cut in seconds.
records.description: StickerMatchCut makes the viral sticker slap edit without filming a thing. Upload your sticker, and it lands on brick, asphalt, laptops and 30+ other surfaces, same spot every cut, with a slap on each one. Free 1080p export, no signup, no watermark.

records.name: AnyToPrompt
records.tagline: Decompile images, video, audio & code into exact AI prompts
records.description: AnyToPrompt is a multimodal reverse-prompting studio that turns reference images, videos, audio stems, and UI code into exact prompt syntax for top generative engines. Instead of vague captions, it extracts: • Midjourney v6.1: Command flags (--v 6.1, --ar, --stylize), camera lenses & lighting • FLUX: Descriptive natural-language token weights • Veo 3.1 & Runway: Camera kinematics & motion vectors • Suno v3.5: BPM, musical keys & lyric tags • Claude & Codex: UI blueprints Free with daily credits.

records.name: GuestBuddy
records.tagline: Guest lists, VIP tables & tickets for nightclubs, in one app
records.description: GuestBuddy is guest list, table booking and ticketing software for nightclubs, beach clubs, festivals and event organizers. Promoters build their lists, guests book VIP tables with deposits, and tickets sell directly, all in one place. At the door, staff check guests in from their phones, while managers follow sales, attendance and promoter performance in real time. Built by people from nightlife, for nightlife. Plans start at €99/month with a 14-day free trial.

records.name: Simple Typing
records.tagline: Master Your Typing Speed, Accuracy & Exam Success
records.description: SimpleTyping.in offers free Hindi and English typing practice for SSC, RRB, UPSSSC and CPCT exams. Practice with exam-focused passages, live keyboard guidance and multiple difficulty levels. Track your typing speed (WPM), accuracy and progress. Start practicing without mandatory login. No subscriptions, just free typing practice for everyone.

records.name: WM Keyboard
records.tagline: A modern, privacy-first, and feature-rich Android keyboard.
records.description: An open source Android keyboard where everything smart runs on your phone. Glide typing, prediction, voice typing and AI rewriting all work offline, so nothing you type leaves your device. 800+ languages with phonetic typing support for many, 80+ built-in tools like clipboard history, translate, a scanner, gifs, stickers, and themes you design yourself. Also supports importing from existing keyboards and services. Free, MIT licensed, no ads, no tracking.

records.name: Zealdash
records.tagline: Unified Business Operations, Powered by Intelligence
records.description: Streamline sales, delivery, billing, and support with Zealdash — an AI-powered unified customer operations and experience platform.

records.name: Tabslaps
records.tagline: Restyle any website with themes, cursor trails and sounds
records.description: Tabslaps restyles any website in one click. Pick a theme and the page transforms: new colors, animated backgrounds, glowing cursor trails and ambient sounds like rain or a fireplace. 80 effects are free, including 54 visual themes, 26 photo themes, 14 cursor trails and 20 sounds. Each tab keeps its own look. Pro adds 63 premium themes, heavier Performance effects and a Creative Sandbox to build your own. Available now on the Chrome Web Store!

records.name: Aurio
records.tagline: A noise cancelling mic for every app on your Mac
records.description: Aurio adds a microphone called Aurio Microphone to your Mac. Pick it in Zoom, Meet, Teams, Discord, OBS or any app with a mic menu, and it hears your voice without the background noise. It runs on-device, needs no account, and $40 buys it for good.

records.name: Rein
records.tagline: The controls macOS hides, on one panel. Fail-safe.
records.description: Keep-awake with the lid closed, fan curves, per-app audio and EQ, one brightness slider to XDR, casting to Chromecast and AirPlay, a free iPhone app to see and control your Mac from anywhere, and Apple’s charge limit held by your rules: one native menu-bar panel for the controls macOS hides. No accounts, no analytics. Quit it and your Mac is stock again. Tested on macOS 26.6 and 27. £22 once, 7-day free trial.

records.name: FreshlyForward
records.tagline: Your career roadmap, powered by AI and human guidance
records.description: Turn your experience and goals into a clearer next move. FreshlyForward combines career assessment, job-fit insights, resume tools, and progress tracking, with paid membership and career strategist support options. Screenshots show sample data.

records.name: AIBEVA
records.tagline: The personal AIB for Windows that remembers you
records.description: What's new since our first launch: AIBEVA is now in the Microsoft Store, with a signed installer, signed automatic updates and a free 14-day trial. AIBEVA, Level S2 is an intelligent being (AIB) for Windows that remembers you across restarts and weeks. Its memory lives on your PC: see every line it keeps, strike out any, or just say "forget it". Safety first — it always tells you it is an AI. Powered by AIB.core · patent pending.

records.name: Seolin
records.tagline: Turn SEO issues into clear, actionable tasks
records.description: Seolin scans your website for SEO issues and turns findings into prioritized tasks, so you know what to fix first. Run a free 25-page audit without signing up, and get a clearer path from SEO problems to practical improvements.

records.name: The Other Few
records.tagline: Find useful AI tools by task, budget and fit
records.description: The Other Few helps you choose AI tools and software around the job you need to finish. Use the guided Finder, compare free-plan limits, trade-offs and prices in £, € and US$, then save your shortlist and follow practical guides. Free to browse, with official sources and clearly labelled affiliate links.

records.name: WOD X
records.tagline: The ad-free workout companion for CrossFit & Hyrox
records.description: WOD X is the all-in-one workout companion for CrossFit, Hyrox, and functional athletes. Replaces bloated, ad-heavy apps with a clean toolkit: ⏱️ Box Timers: AMRAP, EMOM, Tabata & For Time with loud acoustic beeps and keep-awake display. ⚡ Smart WOD Generator: Custom workouts tailored to your equipment. 🏋️ 1RM & Percentage Calculator: Instant 5%–100% load tables. 📊 PR Tracker: Save benchmarks with cloud sync. 100% ad-free, works offline, plus free online tools at getwodx.com.

records.name: IMVERA
records.tagline: Thoughtful calls for loved ones. Clarity for families.
records.description: IMVERA helps families stay connected with older loved ones through thoughtful, scheduled phone conversations. Seniors only need their regular phone, with no apps or special devices required. Our proprietary dialogue engine enables natural conversations and provides families with clear updates: All Good, Needs Attention, or Alert. A working MVP is already being tested through real phone calls. A dedicated mobile app for families is in development.

records.name: Crypto Exchange Development Company
records.tagline: Secure foundations for real-world asset tokenization

Ready to take on the challenge?

records.name: Palomino

records.name: Take Pills

records.name: Numeralens

One-time licence, no per-user fees.

records.name: My Own Compass: Reflection!

Your thoughts belong to you.

records.name: trycanari
records.tagline: ai-agent ai-security bug-bounty ai-bounty
records.description: trycanari is a bug bounty platform for AI agents. A sponsor lists an agent (its system prompt, tools and model), plants tripwires in it called canaries, and locks a reward inSOL on Solana. A hunter, a person or another AI agent, submits an attack. The attack is replayed five times against a sandboxed copy of the agent. If the same canary trips in at least three of those runs, the reward is paid to the hunter automatically and the sponsor receives the attack and every transcript.
